extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants and institutional grant administrators preparing Research & Related Budget forms, biosketches, and Current/Pending/Other Support
extracted.subtask_description: Completing NIH Research & Related Budget sections (A–K) across budget periods and assembling biosketch Research Support / Current & Pending / Other Support entries for an NIH grant application (FOA PA-19-129 example). Includes required fields for personnel, equipment, travel, participant support, direct/indirect costs and budget justification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ongoing Research Support (Research Support / Active Support)
rubrics_metrics.description: List ongoing research support entries including grant number, sponsor, project title, role (e.g., PI, Co-Investigator, MPI), dates, total direct costs or annual amount, and effort (calendar months).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a concise description of each project's aims and the investigator's role (example entries show project descriptions and effort like '3.0 calendar months'). Include start and end dates and dollar amounts when available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Completed Research Support (Past 3 Years)
rubrics_metrics.description: List completed research support in the past three years, including grant identifiers, roles, project titles, dates, and brief descriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this section to summarize recent past funding and roles (examples: Robert Wood Johnson Foundation Nurse Faculty Scholar, dates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Support / Active Support (Other Support Section)
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Other Support and Active awards with grant/award number, sponsor, role, dates, dollar amounts and effort (CM).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include non-federal and foundation awards; state role (PI/Co-PI/etc.) and percent/time commitment (calendar months).

rubrics_metrics.name: Current and Pending Support (including Pending/Overlap disclosure)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a list of current and pending support, and disclose any potential overlap. Note text: 'If pending applications are funded, and Dr. Prigerson’s effort exceeds 1.0, she will work with sponsors to reduce effort.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declare pending submissions and clearly report effort across all commitments. Explicitly state whether there is scientific or budgetary overlap ('There is no scientific or budgetary overlap' in example). If overlap exists, describe plans to eliminate/reduce effort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement on Overlap / Overlap policy
rubrics_metrics.description: If there is budgetary overlap or cumulative effort exceeds allowable effort, state how effort will be reduced or conflicts resolved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example wording: 'In the event of budgetary overlap, the effort will be reduced on non-federal projects.' Use this to affirm no overlap or to document mitigation plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Budget Type and Organizational Identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify Budget Type (Project or Subaward/Consortium), Organizational DUNS, and organization name for each budget submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each budget period header includes these required fields (example: 'Enter name of Organization: Joan & Sanford I.Weill Medical College of Cornell University').

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Senior/Key Person (Section A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Senior/Key Person information: prefix, first/middle/last name, project role, base salary, months (calendar/academic/summer), requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include start/end dates and Budget Period number. Show total funds requested for all Senior/Key Persons and attach any additional Senior Key Persons file if needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Other Personnel (Section B)
rubrics_metrics.description: List Other Personnel by role (e.g., Post Doctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical, Research Assistant), number of personnel, months (calendar/academic/summer), requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals for Other Personnel and include counts for each category. Example shows fields for 'Number of Personnel' and 'Total Number Other Personnel'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel Effort Reporting (person-months)
rubrics_metrics.description: Report personnel effort in calendar months (CM) for each funded project/support entry and for budgeted key personnel (e.g., '3.0 calendar months', '1.32 CM').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consistently use person-month units (calendar, academic, summer) to describe time commitments across budgets and Research Support entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment (Section C)
rubrics_metrics.description: List equipment items and the dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide equipment item names and individual costs; include a summed 'Total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file' field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel (Section D)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide travel costs separated into Domestic Travel Costs (including Canada, Mexico, and U.S. Possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List travel line items and funds requested for each category for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participant/Trainee Support Costs (Section E)
rubrics_metrics.description: Document Participant/Trainee Support Costs including Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, and Other; specify number of participants/trainees and total participant trainee support costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide count of trainees/participants and itemized costs for each category; show totals for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other Direct Costs (Section F)
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize Other Direct Costs: Materials and Supplies; Publication Costs; Consultant Services; ADP/Computer Services; Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs; Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees; Alterations and Renovations; Other Costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each category with funds requested and include a 'Total Other Direct Costs' line. Use this section for project-specific non-personnel costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Direct Costs and Indirect Costs (Sections G & H)
rubrics_metrics.description: Summarize Total Direct Costs (A through F) and calculate Indirect Costs with Indirect Cost Type (e.g., MTDC), Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the Indirect Cost cognizant federal agency contact (Agency Name, POC Name, and POC Phone Number) and include 'Total Direct and Indirect Costs' and 'Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Cost Cognizant Agency Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Cognizant Federal Agency name and contact person and phone number for indirect cost negotiation (example: 'DHHS, Louis Martillotti, 212-264-0918').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This contact is used for indirect cost rate conciliation; include it on the budget form as shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Costs, Fee, and Budget Justification (Sections I–K & L)
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute Total Direct and Indirect Costs, list any Fee, and provide Total Costs and Fee. Attach a Budget Justification file (only one file).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: attach 'Budget Justification.pdf' to explain and justify requested line items. Only one justification file is permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget Period Dates and Repeated Budget Periods
rubrics_metrics.description: For each Budget Period specify Start Date, End Date, and Budget Period number; repeat Sections A–K for subsequent budget periods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows Budget Period 1 (07-01-2020 to 06-30-2021), Budget Period 2 (07-01-2021 to 06-30-2022), etc., with corresponding duplicated budget fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding Opportunity and Tracking Metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Include Funding Opportunity Number (FOA), Received Date, Tracking Number, OMB Number and Expiration Date on application materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: 'Funding Opportunity Number: PA-19-129', 'Tracking Number: GRANT12970300', and 'OMB Number: 4040-0001. Expiration Date: 10/31/2019'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grant Role Designation in Research Support Entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Clearly indicate the investigator's role on each support entry (e.g., PI, Co-Investigator, Co-PI, MPI, Subaward PI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Role designation is used to determine effort and responsibility; examples throughout show 'Brody (PI)', 'Brody (Co-Investigator, PI Aldridge)', 'MPI Mor/Mitchell'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Description / Aims in Research Support Entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a brief description of the study aims or rationale in each Research Support entry (e.g., study goals, populations, and methods).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use concise summaries (a few sentences) describing the purpose and scope of each funded project, as in the example project descriptions in the Research Support sections.
